arguments.command:
python -c "
from glom import Merge, Auto, Check, T, Spec

# Test Check reprs
print('Check():', repr(Check()))
print('Check(type=int):', repr(Check(type=int)))
print('Check(instance_of=dict):', repr(Check(instance_of=dict)))
print('Check(equal_to=5):', repr(Check(equal_to=5)))
print('Check(one_of=[1,2,3]):', repr(Check(one_of=[1,2,3])))
print('Check(validate=lambda x: True):', repr(Check(validate=lambda x: True)))
print('Check(default=42):', repr(Check(default=42)))

# Test Auto repr
print()
print('Auto():', repr(Auto()))
print('Auto(T[0]):', repr(Auto(T[0])))

# Test Merge repr
print()
print('Merge(T[\"a\"]):', repr(Merge(T['a'])))
print('Merge(T[\"a\"], init={}):', repr(Merge(T['a'], init={})))
"
